App Manager

Add and remove the apps H9 Toolbox Firmware runs (hold Back on the radio for the menu), and change the boot logo. Changes are staged here, then written over Bluetooth and read back to verify. Needs H9 Toolbox Firmware on the radio.

Disconnected

Turn on the radio’s Bluetooth programming mode, then click Connect and choose it from the browser’s list.

Advanced: install list and files

Connect to read what is installed, or load a bundle to start offline.

#Name (menu label)CodeRAMCRCActions

What Write to radio will install, in menu order. For development: Add from file takes a .h9mod (one module; the same name replaces it), and Load whole bundle replaces everything including the menu. Apps live in the modules slot of the 16 MiB resource chip (directory 0xCC0000, 124 KiB).
